## Definition of Done

- [ ] One atomic change, scoped to the workspaces it is about (`AGENTS.md`).
- [ ] `bun run check` is green.
- [ ] Tests added or updated.
- [ ] Documentation updated, with the Indonesian mirror where one exists.
- [ ] Changeset added under `.changesets/` if public behaviour, structure, dependencies or deployment changed.
- [ ] No secret, token or credential in code, `PUBLIC_*`, fixtures or logs.
- [ ] Host contract changes bump `HOST_BRIDGE_VERSION` and update every host and the test vectors.
